scenarios.name: Downstream 500 Recovery
scenarios.description: Downstream verification returns HTTP 500. Gateway triggers exponential backoff and succeeds on subsequent attempt.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Retried with exponential backoff + jitter -> eventual success or DLQ

scenarios.name: Downstream 429 Rate Limiting
scenarios.description: Downstream service sends 429 Too Many Requests. Worker pauses and backs off.

scenarios.name: Upstream Gateway Timeout (504)
scenarios.description: Downstream server hangs. Worker times out after 3.0s threshold and safely retries.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Connection timeout detected -> retryable attempt recorded

scenarios.name: Tampered HMAC Signature Rejection
scenarios.description: Incoming request payload is altered in transit. Gateway immediately rejects with 403 Forbidden.
scenarios.expected_behavior: HTTP 403 Forbidden -> not queued to Redis

scenarios.name: High-Frequency Duplicate Burst
scenarios.description: 100 requests with identical provider and event_id sent in parallel.

scenarios.name: Max Retries Exceeded -> DLQ Transition
scenarios.description: Unrecoverable downstream failure triggers 5 consecutive retries before moving event to DLQ.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Attempts 1-5 recorded -> status set to DLQ -> DLQ record created
